builder_environment: Local rootless Podman 5.7.0 on Ubuntu 26.04 WSL2
environment: Ubuntu 26.04 WSL2; kernel 6.18.33.2; local rootless Podman 5.7.0
expected: Determine whether non-privileged rootless Podman supports nested user/mount namespace operations with no-new-privileges and no added capabilities, and compare more restrictive or modified capability sets.
actual: Overall PASSED for identifying a compatible reported profile: local rootless Podman, host user namespaces, rootless container execution, read-only source bind mount, writable output bind mount, nested user namespace with the runtime default capability set, and nested mount namespace/tmpfs all passed. Control profiles failed: --cap-drop=ALL; SETUID+SETGID; and SETUID+SETGID+SETPCAP. Successful nested namespace tests retained no-new-privileges. These control failures are findings, not evidence that every profile passed.
evidence: Operator-provided Sprint 0.3 experimental result matrix. Raw command transcripts and logs were not supplied with the results.
limitations: Experiment date and exact command transcripts were not provided.
The tested capability additions were combinations; no experiment isolated which individual default capability is required.
These results establish the supplied WSL2 observations only; they do not establish Archiso or NixOS ISO build success.
This record does not independently reproduce the reported tests.
